title: Recykal – From waste collection to value recovery (photo-base draft)

slides.heading:
FROM WASTE COLLECTION
TO VALUE RECOVERY:
**BUILDING A BETTER
PATHWAY**
slides.body:
Packaging can **retain value** beyond the product it carries. But littering, improper disposal and gaps in collection systems can
**prevent it from reaching recovery channels.**

callout.text: Recovering that value requires a more organised collection system and **a clear pathway to material recovery.**
